scope: Local Java cache helper profile support; no Codex source or remote workflow changes.
fixture_rust: 1.99.1 native Linux x86-64; dependency-free fixture, not a Codex baseline build

design.missing_behavior: Focused runtime ci-test caches lack content-checked preparation/recording; existing helper only selects release outputs.
design.release_compatibility: Omitted profile keeps release paths and existing snapshots.
design.isolation: ci-test checkout/V8 snapshots live under .codex-source-inputs/ci-test; cleanup and future-output checks select only ci-test host/target directories.
design.recording: Explicit successful recording remains separate from resumable preparation. Failed builds retain partial state without certifying success.
design.next_integration: Install/build helper outside pristine source; restore then prepare before any required Cargo work; record only after required checks and pristine-source/dependency guards. Publish failed state separately.

red_regression.command: mvn -B -ntp -o -f tooling/cli/pom.xml -Dmaven.repo.local=<existing local Maven repository> -Djava.io.tmpdir=<owned CAT_TEMP child> -Dtest=SourceCacheCommandTest#selectsTestProfileBeforeWorkspace test
red_regression.result: 1 test, 1 intended failure: --profile treated as workspace; exit 1 instead of target validation exit 2

verification.command: mvn -B -ntp -o -f tooling/cli/pom.xml -Dmaven.repo.local=<existing local Maven repository> -Djava.io.tmpdir=<owned CAT_TEMP child> verify
behavior_checks: CLI recognizes ci-test before target/workspace processing
Actual ci-test library and executable unchanged-input freshness
Same-timestamp source-byte change rebuilds and emits changed executable output
Focused retry preserves completed ci-test library outputs after a controlled executable failure
ci-test preparation/recording preserve release executable digest and snapshot bytes
verification.quality: javac succeeds; standalone helper POM does not configure Checkstyle or PMD. Existing nonfatal FFM, SLF4J and duplicate tmpdir warnings remain visible.

packaged_runtime.assembly: mvn -B -ntp -o -f tooling/cli/pom.xml <same repository and temporary-directory settings> -Pruntime -DskipTests package

checks: packaged ci-test preparation and successful recording
same-timestamp changed bytes fresh=false and executable output=9
invalid profile exit=2 before workspace access

packaged_runtime.subsequent_help_only_edit: Main usage now advertises the optional profile; runtime recompilation/assembly passes without repeating accepted tests. New packaged no-argument invocation returns 2 and includes profile syntax.

limits: These checks do not establish remote ci-test cache reuse or native macOS/Windows acceptance of the new profile.
No first-dirty trace establishes the cause of earlier restored-helper recompilation.
Existing raw ci-test caches without freshness snapshots require workspace-package invalidation at first preparation; preserving them does not promise zero rebuilds.
Checkpoint 2 and the separate incremental-retry item remain incomplete.
